title: Number Of Strings Which Can Be Rearranged To Contain Substring
description:
# Number of Strings That Can Be Rearranged to Contain a Substring

A lowercase string of length n is good if its characters can be rearranged to form a string containing leet as a contiguous substring. Return the number of good strings modulo 10^9 + 7.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 4
Output: 12
```

```text
Input: n = 10
Output: 83943898
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= n <= 10^5.
